title: SR-1.01 One writer, enforced: an exclusive lock on the vault log
request: Closes G01: Single-writer rule is convention only; runner.mjs opens a Vault beside a live daemon and can corrupt the oplog. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: none.

tasks.title: Exclusive vault lock
requirements: OpLog.open takes an exclusive lock file (O_EXCL with stale-pid recovery) before truncating or rewriting the manifest
a second opener gets a VaultLocked error naming the holder pid
a read-only open mode exists that never mutates the log

the test opens a second writable Vault the way memev claims does (src/cli/main.mjs:327, which opens the vault in process and rewrites .memev/oplog/snapshot.json) beside an open one and asserts VaultLocked and an unchanged snapshot

criteria.statement: Two writers on one vault: the second is refused and the log verifies
The lock error exists in the oplog

tasks.title: Runner goes through the daemon
requirements: runner.mjs no longer constructs new Vault(root) for writes; it calls the daemon over HTTP or opens read-only

criteria.statement: The runner with a live daemon leaves log.verify() ok and no duplicate seq
No writable Vault is opened in runner.mjs
